Creative Medical Technology Holdings, Inc. is an early-stage clinical development company concentrating on stem cell and gene therapy technology to create a pipeline of life-saving and life-enhancing products. The Company has applied these gene delivery technologies to treat degenerative diseases that do not respond to small molecule or biologic drug therapies. The company has filed patent protection for this technology and is looking to identify and in-license gene therapy strategies that, upon approval, could be in-licensed for use as regenerative therapies. Creative Medical has its headquarters in San Diego, CA.
